annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Entry point of famulus-agentd. Exported on the session bus under bus name org.famulus.Agent1 at object path /org/famulus/Agent1. Creates conversation objects and routes permission decisions back to the blocked permission broker.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Spawn one supervised claude CLI process and export a new org.famulus.Conversation1 object at /org/famulus/Agent1/conversations/<id>. Returns the object path of the new conversation.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Answer a pending PermissionRequest identified by request_id. behavior is allow or deny. updated_input_json is the empty string to keep the original tool input, or a canonical-JSON object that replaces it (only meaningful with allow). message is a human-readable reason (only meaningful with deny). Raises org.famulus.Agent1.Error.NotFound for an unknown request_id.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Version string of the running famulus-agentd daemon.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Version string of the supervised claude CLI binary.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: How the claude CLI is authenticated. One of: oauth, api-key, none.
